implementation_boundary: Identity profile and verified contact remain in the Auth provider; tenant membership stores authorization only.
Project and location scope tables are the canonical membership link; there is no second membership table.
Only validation/result rows are stored; the immutable source file remains authoritative.
Project reporting policy creates explicit periods; no mutable calendar table is authoritative.
Requirement waiver is the only readiness exception record.
Original and derivative use one object table with immutable lineage.
GA v1 stores versioned structured breakdown in the immutable version; normalize only after measured query need.
Issued versions and append-only decisions are canonical; generic chat is intentionally excluded.
Retention basis is an adjustment and each release is append-only; no free-floating schedule mutates receivable truth.
Plan identity and version are one immutable catalog record.
Feature keys are validated configuration rather than mutable tenant rows.
Immutable plan JSON plus server validation is canonical until catalog scale justifies normalization.
Time-bound signed override is the supported Pilot and GA extension mechanism.
Raw per-action billing event storage is deferred; domain events and periodic immutable snapshots prevent a second analytics ledger.
Pilot invoices are single-line; normalized lines require accountant-approved multi-line tax cases before enablement.
Pilot payment targets one invoice; many-to-many allocation is disabled until a verified accounting case exists.
Cancel and credit corrections are append-only invoice adjustments.
Capture task is the UX name for an immutable assignment version; it is never an assignee field on a contract line.
An occurrence is the executable requirement instance for one assignment scope and exact rule and reference versions.
Controlled reference revision is the immutable published version used by assignments occurrences captures and packages.
Accounting cost code stays inside the stored source import file until an accounting adapter maps it; no Pilot domain column.
